name: Carry a Monkey [2 Player Obby]
desc:
🐵 Carry your monkey buddy in a backpack, and make your way through wild and challenging obstacles!

Choose between being the monkey (🐵) or the person carrying the monkey (🎒). Unlock fun skins for your monkey and backpack as you progress!

⭐ Will you and your friend survive the journey together?

Report bugs on the group wall in our group!
